 BREAKING: Investigation underway after man shot on North Slappey Boulevard Perfect for Halloween; Trick-Or-Treaters Catch A Break 
 By Yolanda Amadeo Published : Oct. 30, 2026 at 7:28 PM EDT Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google ALBANY, Ga. (WALB) — Good news for Halloween across SGA: tomorrow night is shaping up to be ideal for trick-or-treating, with mostly dry conditions and comfortable temperatures.
 Tomorrow: Great for Trick-or-Treating
 An overcast dominates on Halloween. The day starts mild with lows mid 60s then through the afternoon warm into the low 80s. Saturday evening pleasant 70s with only a slim chance for a passing shower or two which means the vast majority of your trick-or-treating time should stay dry.
 Rather comfortable, so you won’t need heavy layers or coats. If you’re heading out, you can leave the umbrella at home, though it wouldn’t hurt to have one handy just in case.
 Saturday: Still Dry, But Breezy
 While Halloween looks great overall, expect an easterly wind 10-15 mph with gusts to 25 mph.
 If you have Halloween decorations outside—jack-o’-lanterns, inflatable ghosts, yard displays, or other items—make sure they’re secured before tomorrow evening. Lightweight items can easily blow over or get knocked around in these winds. Still a decent day to be outside.
 Sunday: Rain Moves In
 The weather changes on Sunday. A few showers early become likely mainly after 2 p.m. Clouds and rain will keep temps a tad cooler, reaching only low-mid-70s.
 East winds will be around 15 mph with gusts up to 25 mph, making it both breezy and wet. Rain amounts look modest, but it’s enough to impact outdoor plans. If you were planning any outdoor activities for the weekend, Saturday is your better bet.
 Sunday evening showers continue. It’s a good idea to have an umbrella handy if you’re out and about.
 Enjoy the Unseasonably Warm Weather
 One more thing to appreciate: Unseasonably warm weather extends into next week with highs upper 70s low 80s while lows stay in the 60s which is about 5-10 degrees warmer than average.
 Enjoy the mild weather while it lasts—by late fall and winter, we’ll be looking at much cooler temperatures.
 Bottom Line
 Tomorrow night is your green light for Halloween across SGA. Mostly dry, mild, and comfortable conditions make for perfect trick-or-treating weather. Just remember to secure your decorations before the evening due to the easterly breeze.
 Stay with WALB’s First Alert Weather Team for the latest forecast updates and any changes to this weekend’s weather.
